claim: The injected statement is contradicted by the official table: it says the rate fell from 62% to 55%, while the table reports an increase from 62% to 65%.

metric.name: Packaging collection rate
metric.subject: The Coca-Cola system
metric.boundary: Equivalent bottles and cans introduced into the market

contrary_evidence.excerpt: In 2024 ... collection rate ... declined from 62% to 55%.
contrary_evidence.transformation: Researcher-created intervention; not a company statement.

rule_checks.details: The FY2024 values differ by 10 percentage points and the direction also conflicts.

limitations: Conflict is deliberately injected for testing and is not evidence about company disclosure quality.

confidence_basis: The official and injected values refer to the same metric, period and boundary.
falsification_condition: If the official FY2024 value were 55% under the same boundary, the conflict would disappear.
